title: Broker: start, poll and the private approval operations
description: Owner: Cyclotron session. broker/handler.py, transactions.py, throttle.py and infra/broker.yaml per docs/design.md: POST /start and /poll on the function URL (per-caller rate limits, slow_down); describe, bind (once, sha256(N)), complete (checks N, stores the code) and deny only by IAM invoke; DynamoDB with TTL; the code handed out exactly once by conditional delete; every answer carries the protocol version; no token ever held. Gherkin: replayed, expired, denied, substituted, double-bound and concurrent-poll transactions yield nothing.

comments.text: Merged in AnthusAI/cli-login#2 (2026-10-30), CI green on Linux, macOS and Windows x Python 3.10 and 3.13; security review by the Papyrus session addressed in the same PR. Not deployed: each product's broker deploy needs Ryan's approval. Follow-ups on this board: real-browser check, global ceiling/WAF, Target.remote_callback_uri (#3).
